items.reasoning_exact: The adservice container serves gRPC/HTTP2 on port 9555 (readinessProbe correctly uses grpc on 9555), but the livenessProbe is configured as httpGet on the same port. The kubelet's HTTP/1.x probe receives HTTP/2 binary preface bytes, which it parses as a malformed HTTP status code, so the liveness probe fails repeatedly. After 3 consecutive failures (period=10s, failureThreshold=3), kubelet kills the container (Last State: Terminated, Exit Code 143) and restarts it, producing the observed abnormal restarts (Restart Count: 2). The fix is to change the livenessProbe to grpc on port 9555, matching the readinessProbe. This is the supported cause; no evidence rules out concurrent contributing factors, but the probe protocol mismatch directly explains the kill/restart cycle.
